title: Aurora PostgreSQL Cluster Provisioning
description: Provision an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL cluster as migration target.

steps.action: Create DB Subnet Group: select private subnets across 2+ AZs
steps.verify: Subnet group status = Complete; subnets in correct VPC

steps.action: Create Aurora PostgreSQL cluster: engine 16.x, instance class r6g.large (or per sizing), Multi-AZ enabled, encrypted with KMS key
steps.verify: Cluster status = Available; writer endpoint resolves via nslookup

steps.action: Create database and migration user: CREATE USER dms_user WITH PASSWORD '...'; GRANT CONNECT, CREATE ON DATABASE analytics TO dms_user
Enable enhanced monitoring and Performance Insights: CloudWatch granularity 1s, 7-day retention
steps.verify: Performance Insights dashboard shows activity in RDS console

steps.action: Enable pgvector extension: CREATE EXTENSION vector; verify version
steps.verify: SELECT extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname='vector' returns >= 0.7.0
steps.rollback: DROP EXTENSION vector CASCADE (only if no vector columns)
